sections.text:
-Target: all allies. Recovers 60% of max HP.
HP recovery boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies 40% damage reflection for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 20.
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 60 seconds.
-Applies Element of Destiny for 120 seconds (all stats are boosted by 50%, critical hit rate is boosted by 50%, and max HP is boosted 50%).
Boosts stats of star Monsters by 20% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 10000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 10000

[Bountiful Destiny] Urd & Verdandi or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
